# technitium_settings_logging (Data Source)

Reads what `technitium_settings_logging` manages, without managing it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enable_in_memory_stats` (Boolean) Keep dashboard stats in memory only. The dashboard then shows only the last hour and nothing is stored on disk.
- `id` (String) The identifier, as the resource has it.
- `ignore_resolver_logs` (Boolean) Leave name resolution errors out of the log.
- `log_folder` (String) The folder for log files, absolute or relative to the server's config folder. Technitium's default is `logs`.
- `log_queries` (Boolean) Log every query and its answer. Technitium's default is `false`.
- `logging_type` (String) Where error and audit logs go: `None`, `File`, `Console` or `FileAndConsole`. Technitium's default is `File`.
- `max_log_file_days` (Number) The days log files are kept before they are deleted. `0` keeps them forever; `365` is recommended.
- `max_stat_file_days` (Number) The days dashboard stats are kept before they are deleted. `0` keeps them forever; `365` is recommended.
- `no_stack_trace` (Boolean) Log short error messages without stack traces.
- `use_local_time` (Boolean) Log in local time instead of UTC. Technitium's default is `false`.
